'''Boris Ivanovich Katorgin''' ({{langx|ru|Борис Иванович Каторгин}}; born 13 October 1934 in [[Solnechnogorsk]]) is a Russian scientist who is known for his development of commercially successful [[rocket engine]] systems.<ref name="processcontroltodayallam2012">{{cite news
 | url = http://www.pandct.com/media/shownews.asp?ID=33358
 | title = IChemE Fellow Rodney Allam has been awarded the 2012 Global Energy Prize
 | date = 27 June 2012
 | newspaper = Process and Control Today
 | access-date = 29 November 2016
 | archive-date = 1 December 2016
 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20161201080000/http://www.pandct.com/media/shownews.asp?ID=33358
 | url-status = dead
 }}</ref><ref name="geplaureatekatorgin">{{cite web
 | url = http://www.globalenergyprize.org/en/laureates/2012/laureate-2
 | title = Boris Ivanovich Katorgin (Russia)
 | publisher = [[Global Energy Prize]]
 | access-date = 30 December 2016
 }}</ref><ref name="bmstukatorginbirthdate">{{cite web
 | url = http://www.bmstu.ru/scholars/katorgin_b_i
 | title = Каторгин Борис Иванович
 | language = ru
 | publisher = [[Bauman Moscow State Technical University]]
 | access-date = 30 December 2016
 | archive-date = 6 February 2017
 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20170206214954/http://www.bmstu.ru/scholars/katorgin_b_i
 | url-status = dead
 }}</ref>

== Career ==

Katorgin graduated from the [[Bauman Moscow State Technical University]] in 1958 and became [[Doctor of Technology]] in 1983. He joined the [[NPO Energomash]] rocket engine manufacturer in 1958 and was its CEO and chief designer between 1991 and 2005. He has been a full member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] since 2003.<ref name="geplaureatekatorgin" /><ref name="survincitykatorgin2013">{{cite news
 | url = http://survincity.com/2013/12/creator-of-the-world-s-best-liquid-rocket-engine/
 | title = Creator of the world's best liquid rocket engine RD-180, RD-170 academician B. Katorgin explains
 | last = Imamutdinov
 | first = Irik
 | date = 18 December 2013
 | newspaper = Surviving in the city
 | access-date = 30 November 2016
 }}</ref><ref name="raskatorgin75">{{cite web
 | url = http://www.ras.ru/news/shownews.aspx?id=d51a3a51-d424-44f8-a6f6-228cf1c1614f&print=1
 | title = Академику Каторгину Борису Ивановичу - 75 лет!
 | date = 13 October 2009
 | language = ru
 | publisher = [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]
 | access-date = 30 December 2016
 }}</ref>

Katorgin is mainly known for his work on [[cryogenic]] [[liquid-propellant rocket]] engines. He was the CEO and chief designer of NPO Energomash during the development of the [[RD-180]] engine, which has been exported to the [[United States]] for driving [[Atlas III]] and [[Atlas V]] rockets. He was also involved in the development of the earlier and twice as powerful [[RD-170]] engine. As of 2000, when the first RD-180-powered Atlas III rocket flew, the engine was considered to be 15 to 20 percent more fuel-efficient than competing designs. Katorgin has also contributed to the study of [[nuclear pulse propulsion]], [[chemical laser]]s and [[superconducting]] systems for power transmission.<ref name="geplaureatekatorgin" /><ref name="survincitykatorgin2013" /><ref name="raskatorgin75" /><ref name="popsciencekatorgin2010">{{cite journal
 | url = https://books.google.com/books?id=xA5vzkW8IDsC&dq=RD-180+katorgin&pg=PA56
 | title = Rocket's Red Glare
 | last = Schefter
 | first = Jim
 | issue = August
 | volume = 2010
 | journal = [[Popular Science]]
 | date = August 2000
 | access-date = 30 November 2016
 }}</ref>

In 2012, along with [[Valery Kostuk]] and [[Rodney John Allam]], Katorgin received the [[Global Energy Prize]] for his research and development relating to high-efficiency and reliable cryogenic-fuel-powered rocket propellant engines.<ref name="processcontroltodayallam2012" /><ref name="geplaureatekatorgin" /><ref name="survincitykatorgin2013" />
